sector_notes: On 5 November, SPY fell 4.41%, QQQ 6.49% and IWM 4.59%; 91 of 109 names in the StockLens sector-screen universe declined, confirming broad risk-off breadth. Technology (XLK -8.00%), industrials (XLI -4.12%) and energy (XLE -2.98% on the day and -7.57% over three sessions) were weakest, while consumer staples (XLP -0.75% daily, +2.59% over three sessions), communication services (XLC -0.59%, +2.86%) and healthcare (XLV -2.50%, +0.48%) showed relative resilience. The October employment report showed 165,000 payroll gains versus 65,000 expected and 4.1% unemployment; early futures at 8:31 ET were mixed, with Nasdaq-100 +1.37% and Dow futures -0.96%, so the technology rebound is not yet a broad risk-on signal. Price and volume validation uses the latest completed regular session, 5 November, because the 6 November U.S. cash session had not opened at the time of this run.
